Note : Promoter and Promoter Group - Shares pledged or otherwise encumbered
As informed by the Promoter - Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited (IL&FS), IL&FS as a Promoter ofIL&FS Investment Managers Limited (IIML) has offered shares of IIML, held by it as a part of the total assets to theDebenture Trustee to safeguard the interest of Debenture Holders. Accordingly, the total security package offered to theDebenture Trustees, inter alia includes shares of IIML and hence there is a lien in favour of the Debenture Trustee.Considering that the transaction is not "Loan against securities", specific charge against the shares held by IL&FS in IIMLis not marked as pledge with IL&FS's Depository Participant.
However, based on the promoters declarations pursuant to Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquistion ofShares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, the Company has classified 158,333,152 shares held by IL&FS under "Shares held by promoters are encumbered, other than by way of Pledge or NDU, if any" in its shareholding pattern
